propositions: The snapshot-entry contract is hand-rolled in _snapshot_schema.py outside the enforced schemas machinery and is never imported by the producer (fetcher.py), leaving the contract unenforced
The snapshot schema encodes a parent presence/absence distinction that gates inbound CLEAR operations with destructive side effects but lacks validation enforcement

Real fetcher output exists in bridge_state/snapshots/ covering all three snapshot entry shapes (populated, parent-absent, empty) but is gitignored and contains PII, requiring redaction into tracked fixtures

The snapshot contract must be migrated from _snapshot_schema.py into src/rebar/schemas/ and integrated into the existing schemas.load()/jsonschema/Draft202012Validator drift gate to achieve automatic enforcement parity with 90 sibling schemas
A producer field change diverging from the contract must fail CI validation via the generated-types drift gate (python -m rebar.schemas.gen_types)
